白毛（17）➡️黒毛：自分が加入すれば必ず優勝できると考えており、黒毛の態度を見下している。元チャンピオンだとしても、自分の実力で全てを証明してみせると意気込んでいる。

I really love your illustrations. Whether it's the atmosphere or the sense of interaction between the characters, they are excellent and give off a very adorable feeling! So I would like to invite you to help draw an interactive scene featuring my OCs. Below are brief introductions of the two characters and an outline of the commission. Thank you very much for taking the time to read this.

① Red-haired male: 蓮見凪, 20 years old, 187 cm tall, with dark red hair and dark green eyes, droopy eyes. He always wears over-ear headphones around his neck. He is a university student and the guitarist of a rock band. Due to certain experiences, he hates himself, so he always seems distant from others.

② Black-haired male: 鍾余, 22 years old, 186 cm tall, with a mole under his left eyebrow, cat scratch scars on his neck, and slightly upturned eyes. He is the bassist of the rock band. He has little sense of shame, so he often does many incredible things with an expressionless face.

◆ Their relationship: The two are both members of the same rock band and also friends. Because 蓮見凪 always looks unwell, 鍾余 likes to cook him lots of delicious food to help him regain his strength, while 蓮見凪 finds this quite annoying.

◆ The content I would like to commission: I want to see 鍾余 dressed as a maid from a maid café, drawing a heart-shaped curry omurice for 蓮見凪, and 蓮見凪 is quite troubled by this! Please consider this scene as a reference; feel free to interpret it as you like. As for the outfit, you may refer to the URL provided below, but your own creative input is also very welcome!
